upstream.note: Merged upstream collection is not canonical consumption. No retroactive sweep, accepted event or release is inferred.

methodology: Atomic ordinary-meaning propositions; exact actor/date/statement versus carrier date; factual truth separately from actor knowledge. A report of a statement can be verified as reporting while its physical or political outcome remains unverified. UNSUBSTANTIATED is not FALSE, and FALSE is not knowing deception. Shared official source or wire syndication is not independent corroboration. Proposed source edges are referrals only, not protected WOL-native findings.

candidates.actor: Khaama Press attributing to Al Jazeera and unidentified maritime security data
candidates.exact_reported_language: At least 35 attacks on commercial ships in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz in October, described as record month.
proposition_decomposition: October attack tally is at least 35 under the unidentified dataset's scope
Reuters on October23 reported 28 confirmed and reported attacks in October from Noam Raydan's Washington Institute dataset (earlier cutoff and named provider)
IMO as-of October30 reports 122 cumulative confirmed incidents and 24 seafarer deaths (different geographic/time population)
candidates.support: Reuters October23 explicitly identifies Raydan and 28 October attacks at that time; IMO cumulative registry is primary but not a direct comparable October count.
candidates.contrary_or_limits: 28 as of Oct23 does not falsify 35 by Oct31; 122 all-war incidents does not corroborate 35 October ship attacks. Khaama underlying 35 methodology, original Al Jazeera report, exact cutoff and incident/hull unit unavailable.
candidates.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED for 35 as exact source-qualified count; no affirmative FALSE finding
candidates.knowledge: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for source awareness of discrepancies; no documented correction opportunity
lineage: Khaama -> Al Jazeera ATTRIBUTES_TO (original report and underlying data not independently recovered)
Al Jazeera -> unnamed maritime data CLAIMED_DERIVATION only; do not assert proven provider edge
Reuters Oct23 -> Noam Raydan/Washington Institute dataset ATTRIBUTES_TO; Al-Monitor carries Reuters wire, not independent provider
candidates.repetition_vs_novel: New numerical carrier variant of ongoing Hormuz attack accounting, not 35 new canonical events or unique lies
candidates.missing: Original Al Jazeera report, dataset provider/methodology, UTC cutoff, unique IMO hull/event reconciliation, later corrections.
